source_review.notes: Checked the ISO/IEC 9899:2024 catalog record, Java SE 26 JLS chapters 4 and 5, current Rust Reference operator and cast semantics, and current SEI CERT C INT30-C/INT31-C guidance. Text distinguishes language guarantees and does not universalize hardware behavior.

evidence: Reviewed definitions of U_w, S_w, N_w, T_w, signed and unsigned endpoints, checked conversion, saturation, and expression-policy notation.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Widths are positive, bit indices are consistent, ranges include endpoints, and each symbol is defined before substantive use.

Executed fixed-width-integer-model with exact expected output.
Recomputed 250+10 modulo 256, 200+100 modulo 256, and little-endian FE FF decoding.
numerical_recomputation.notes: All numerical examples and answer values agree with independent arithmetic and the deterministic snippet report.

evidence: Derived S_w(b)=U_w(b)-2^w when the high bit is one.
Checked range-containment criterion for value-preserving conversion.
Derived checked addition and nonnegative multiplication guards.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Derivations state their nonnegative, width, and nonzero-divisor premises.

evidence: Checked zero, one, maxima, minima, signed minimum negation, minimum divided by minus one, one-past-range conversion, shift-width, mixed-sign comparison, and count-times-size cases.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Exercises include explicit neighbor values in an adequately wide review representation; safety-critical examples require domain validation beyond arithmetic.

evidence: Traced bits to typed value, exact result, overflow policy, and destination conversion.
Checked that guards execute before dangerous operations.
Checked external fields specify width, signedness, byte order, admissible range, and invalid-value policy.
invariant_checking.notes: The chapter consistently separates representation, operator semantics, application policy, and trust-boundary validation.

evidence: Reviewed range proof for u16 to i32 conversion.
Reviewed necessity and sufficiency of x <= M-y for nonnegative checked addition.
Reviewed x <= floor(M/y) multiplication proof under y>0.
proof_review.notes: Claims are bounded to their stated premises and do not infer source-language semantics from the mathematical model.

evidence: Searched the chapter's theorem, proof, model, and evidence language.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Complete elementary derivations are identified as proofs; the executable Python is explicitly labeled a mathematical model rather than a universal language implementation. No unlabeled proof sketch is presented.

evidence: Reviewed executable snippet framing and all implementation/current-language claims.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Snippet output verifies only the deterministic model. Language claims cite specifications; no benchmark, deployment, safety, or empirical effectiveness claim is made.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed the four-stage representation/value/result/policy/conversion model, distinctions among overflow policies, promotion traces, binary boundaries, and domain-policy examples for internal consistency.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed allocation arithmetic, untrusted length conversion, signed/unsigned comparison, sequence rollover, protocol decoding, and safety-critical limitations. This is internal practitioner-oriented review only.

pedagogical_review.notes: Verified progression from positional representation through policies and conversions to production boundaries; ten examples have distinct purposes and five exercises progress from retrieval to safety-case transfer with complete model answers.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
